visa_10.4.name: Other Fraud, Card Absent
requirements: 2+ prior undisputed transactions same card/address in last 12 months
Proof of cardholder identity/device consistency
Signed delivery to verified billing address

visa_10.5.name: Visa Fraud Monitoring
visa_10.5.note: ⚠️ RARELY REPRESENTABLE — Accept Liability unless issuer error
requirements: Only defend if issuer admits miscoding

visa_12.6.1.name: Duplicate Processing
requirements: Separate Order IDs/items/dates prove distinct purchases
Independent invoices/delivery records exist
Unique authorization codes/timestamps for each

visa_13.1.name: Merchandise/Services Not Received
requirements: Valid tracking + carrier + confirmed delivery status
Delivery date BEFORE chargeback date
Address matches purchase/shipping records

visa_13.2.name: Cancelled Recurring Transaction
requirements: Published terms: recurring nature + clear cancel method
Billing notification sent minimum 5 days before renewal
No cancellation request received BEFORE charge date
Proof of original opt-in/consent

visa_13.3.name: Merchandise/Services Not As Described
requirements: Original published product/service description at purchase
Evidence delivered item matches description
Return/refund policy clearly offered

mastercard_4837.name: No Cardholder Authorisation
requirements: Full AVS address match + valid CVV result
Successful 3D Secure authentication
2+ prior undisputed transactions within 12 months
Proof of delivery to verified billing address

mastercard_4855.name: Goods/Services Not Provided
requirements: Tracking/carrier confirmation OR service proof records
Fulfillment date strictly BEFORE chargeback date
Consistent address details across purchase/delivery

mastercard_4859.name: No‑Show / Cancellation
requirements: Valid booking/reservation confirmation document
Policy (non‑refund/cancel) DISCLOSED + ACCEPTED at booking
Proof of no‑show OR cancellation outside allowed window
Charged amount matches published policy exactly
